item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00286","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C04","C02","C08"],"selected_candidate_label":"C04","confidence":0.93,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C04 is the clear predecessor: its title nearly exactly matches the child's, and it contains the substantive machinery of suspending statutory employment restrictions for a specified fiscal year because of a housing shortage. C08 also concerns excluding positions from statutory employment rules, but its machinery and target differ materially.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"suspending certain statutory provisions relating employment the","parent_excerpt":"suspending certain statutory provisions relating employment the canal","explanation":"The nearly identical titles identify the same specific suspension mechanism and subject matter."},{"child_excerpt":"suspending certain statutory provisions","parent_excerpt":"I hereby suspend for the fiscal year 1949 the application of those portions of the cited sections of the respective Acts","explanation":"C04 supplies concrete operative language for a time-limited suspension of specified statutory provisions."},{"child_excerpt":"relating employment","parent_excerpt":"which require employment of citizens of the Republic of Panama or of the United States in skilled, technical clerical, administrative, executive, or supervisory positions","explanation":"The predecessor applies the suspension specifically to statutory employment requirements, matching the child's stated subject."}]}
